items.title: Behemoth Storyboards - PROOF OF CONCEPT
items.summary: Behemoth is an original animated series currently in development. This proof-of-concept short episode explores the show's core premise, visual tone, and character dynamics, following the main cast as they navigate getting lost in a mysterious forest.

items.title: Sym-Bionic Titan - Animation Master Study
items.summary: A master study from Sym-Bionic Titan to practice lighting, shape language, and composition.Original artwork and characters belong to creators Genndy Tartakovsky, Bryan Andrews, Paul Rudish, and Cartoon Network Studios. Made strictly for educational and practice purposes!
